en.title: Haunted Hotel Season 2 Haunts Netflix This Halloween
en.summary: Get ready to check back in! Netflix's beloved adult animated comedy Haunted Hotel officially returns for its second season on October 9, 2026. The announcement came with a meta teaser trailer featuring a fan-favorite demon.
en.body:
Get your reservations ready! Right in time for the spooky season, Netflix’s hit adult animated comedy **Haunted Hotel** is officially returning for Season 2 on October 9th, 2026. This highly anticipated sophomore season, previously known in development as *The Undervale*, is set to deliver eight new episodes to binge-watchers.

The show, created by **Matt Roller**, captured audiences with its unique blend of supernatural chaos and dysfunctional family dynamics. Its debut season proved a significant hit, pulling in 1.8 million views in its opening week and charting in the daily Top 10 in 56 countries, including major markets like the US, Canada, and the UK. This strong performance was crucial, especially given the often-anxious landscape for adult animation on the platform.

Showrunner **Matt Roller** himself has acknowledged the fan anxiety surrounding Netflix's commitment to the genre, noting the common sentiment: “This looks great. Can’t wait for Netflix to cancel it.” Fortunately, the audience showed up, and as **Roller** pointed out, “If people watch, we will get to make more.” The success of **Haunted Hotel** is a testament to its surprising emotional depth, stellar voice acting, and genuinely hilarious dialogue, which the cast was able to develop through a mix of Zoom and in-person table reads.

## The Demon Returns

To announce the Season 2 premiere, Netflix dropped a brand-new, meta teaser trailer that immediately set the tone. The clip features everyone's favorite pint-sized terror, **Abaddon**, voiced by **Jimmi Simpson** (whose iconic Season 1 line delivery of “JAAAAAARBON” is still memorable). In the teaser, **Abaddon** literally takes over the Netflix homepage, swatting away popular titles like **Stranger Things**, **Wednesday**, and **Black Mirror** to clear the screen. His declaration, “Fools! I decide when I return,” is a playful nod to the show’s own release schedule, before he warns that the demon hunters are close behind. The trailer’s impressive use of the latest website redesign and its meta-humor has already made it a fan favorite.

## Fan Anticipation Reaches Fever Pitch

Fans have been eagerly awaiting confirmation of **Haunted Hotel**’s return. The announcement of Season 2 came swiftly after the first season's release, with recording for **Jimmi Simpson** reportedly beginning as early as February 1st, 2026. This quick turnaround signals strong confidence from Netflix and a smooth production process. The community's reaction online has been overwhelmingly positive, with many expressing relief and excitement that their favorite dysfunctional supernatural family is checking back in. The show’s ability to weave genuine heart into its comedic horror has clearly resonated, making the wait for more episodes feel particularly long.

## What's Next

With **Haunted Hotel** Season 2 officially set to premiere on October 9th, 2026, fans have a clear date to mark on their calendars. The eight-episode season promises more demonic antics and family drama, perfectly timed for the Halloween season.
